import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df['brand'].unique()))
brand_colors = dict(zip(df['brand'].unique(), colors))

# 1. Price by Brand (Bar chart)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bars = ax1.bar(df['brand'], df['price_usd'], color=[brand_colors[b] for b in df['brand']])
ax1.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price by Brand')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar, price in zip(bars, df['price_usd']):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 50, 
             f'${price:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price (Scatter)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax2.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=[brand_colors[brand]], label=brand, s=100, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Weight Distribution by Body Type
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
body_weights = [df[df['body_type'] == bt]['weight_grams'].values for bt in body_types]
bp = ax3.boxplot([df[df['body_type'] == bt]['weight_grams'].tolist() for bt in body_types], 
                  labels=body_types, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], sns.color_palette("Set2", len(body_types))):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax3.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)')
ax3.set_title('Weight by Body Type')

# 4. Sensor Type Distribution (Pie chart)
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax4.pie(sensor_counts, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=sns.color_palette("pastel"), startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution')

# 5. Model Year vs Max ISO
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['model_year'], df['max_iso'], c=df['megapixels'], 
                       cmap='viridis', s=150, edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax5.set_ylabel('Max ISO')
ax5.set_title('Model Year vs Max ISO\n(color = megapixels)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Megapixels')

# 6. 4K Video Capability
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
video_counts = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', 'Has 4K']
colors_4k = ['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4']
ax6.bar([labels[i] for i in video_counts.index], video_counts.values, color=colors_4k)
ax6.set_xlabel('4K Video Capability')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')
ax6.set_title('4K Video Support')
for i, v in enumerate(video_counts.values):
    ax6.text(i, v + 0.05, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
